description:
Cast Proctor of Potential by paying {W}{U}.
When Proctor of Potential enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Proctor of Potential triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.
